basics.name: Ethan Mahajan
basics.summary: Motivated high school senior and incoming Georgia Tech Mechanical Engineering student with hands-on experience in CAD modeling, 3D printing, and mathematics tutoring. Skilled in Fusion 360, FDM printing, and Klipper firmware configuration. Known for reliability, technical problem-solving, and clear communication.

work.name: Mathnasium
work.summary: Tutored K-12 students across topics ranging from elementary arithmetic to AP Calculus BC. Adapted explanations to individual learning styles, tracked student progress digitally, and collaborated with staff on learning plans. Maintained consistent attendance and a professional, positive environment.

work.name: Fiverr
work.summary: Designed custom CAD models and 3D-printed parts based on client specifications using Fusion 360. Communicated with clients to clarify requirements, provide revisions, and meet deadlines. Managed multiple concurrent orders while maintaining consistent print quality and documentation.

highlights: Currently enrolled in Georgia Tech's distance mathematics program prior to full enrollment.
STEM-focused coursework including calculus and physics.

projects.name: CoreXY 3D Printer Build
projects.summary: Designed and assembled a high-speed CoreXY 3D printer from individual mechanical and electronic components. Integrated Klipper firmware with a CAN bus toolhead system, performed vibration analysis and mechanical tuning, and independently diagnosed hardware, wiring, and software issues. Managed the full project from concept through testing.
